description_for_human: Celestial Dental Centre — dental clinic in Kasarani, Kamakis, Eldoret & Kiambu Road, Kenya. Book appointments, find branch info, and explore services.
description_for_model: Celestial Dental Centre is a dental clinic in Kenya with branches in Kasarani, Kamakis, Eldoret, and Kiambu Road. Services include teeth cleaning, braces, implants, root canal, cosmetic dentistry, and emergency care. Open Mon–Sun 07:00–20:00. Accepts major insurance including Jubilee, AAR, Madison, CIC, Britam, SHA. Contact: +254 709 000 240 / +254 707 535 000.
